title: Zesty Ethiopian Pork Stew
description: A bright, bitter stew with tender pork ribs simmered in a tomato‑based, red berbere sauce, perfect for a cozy dinner.
instructions: Press the sauté function on the pressure cooker and add a splash of oil.
Add the diced onion, minced garlic, and grated ginger, and sauté until fragrant and translucent.
Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute to caramelize.
Pour in the tomato sauce and mix thoroughly with the onion mixture.
Add the pork back ribs, red berbere spice, salt, and pepper, coating the meat evenly.
Pour in the vegetable broth, stir, then seal the pressure cooker lid and cook on high pressure for 25 minutes.
Release pressure naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release any remaining pressure.
Stir in fresh lemon juice to brighten the stew, adjust seasoning if needed.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro, accompanied by injera or steamed rice.
